body.name: Branch tangent spaces
body.construction: \(\mathcal T_b(P)\) is the \(L^2(P_O)\)-closure of scores \(s\) of regular quadratic-mean differentiable observed-data submodels \((P_{O,\varepsilon})\) through \(P_O\) that are induced by full-data submodels in branch \(b\). For PT, the latent path \(\delta_{1,\varepsilon}^0(x)\) is profiled freely; for SC, the full-rank weight path is profiled through \(B(P_{O,\varepsilon})\).
